title: Traveling exhibit
brief: The original delivery of four cartons of exhibit labels to museum delivery desk has fallen through. The city museum needs a replacement shipment in time for the installation crew's visit. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
Hi all, Sam here at the museum delivery desk. From the receiving side, here's what any booking has to fit:

The load has to be handed to a person at the delivery desk no later than 11:00. Arriving at 11:00 exactly is fine, anything after that I can't accept. It can't be left unattended, so no drop-and-go service, and I'm the one who arranges the staffed handover, so please confirm the arrival time with me before anything is booked.

To line that up, I need a few things:

- Ellis: when will all four cartons be ready for pickup? They need to travel together as one load.
- Taylor: which services can collect after Ellis's ready time and get here by 11:00, and what's the realistic arrival time for each?
- Morgan: what's the budget ceiling, so we can pick from Taylor's options that actually work?

Once I have a firm arrival time, I'll confirm someone is at the desk to sign for it.

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text:
Hi all, I'm the one who signs off on the cost for this replacement shipment, so here's what I need to get it booked today.

My hard ceiling is 99 crowns all-in, covering every fee and surcharge. I can't approve anything over that, so please quote me total prices, not base rates.

To approve, I need three things:

- **Ellis:** when will all four cartons be packed and ready for pickup? They have to travel together as one load.
- **Sam:** what hours can the delivery desk receive, and what's the latest arrival that still works for the installation crew?
- **Taylor:** which services can make that pickup and delivery window, and what is the all-in price for each?

As soon as there's an option that fits the ready time, the receiving window and the 99-crown cap, I'll authorize it right away.

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text: I can release all four cartons together for pickup at 09:15 or later today. Sam, when can the museum desk receive them, and what’s the latest they can arrive for installation? Taylor, please quote a service that meets that window and confirm pickup and arrival times. Morgan, can you confirm the budget and approve the booking once we have a quote?

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
I can book all four cartons together. The quotes below are all-in, with pickup first and guaranteed staffed handover second. V479 is 09:31 → 11:09 for 45 crowns, V153 is 09:32 → 10:36 for 65, V321 is 09:36 → 10:21 for 69, and V323 is 09:27 → 10:11 for 96.

Ellis, when will all four cartons be ready? Sam, what handover window works for the desk and crew? Morgan, what spend can you approve? I’ll book the lowest-priced service that fits.

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
I can reserve V153 for all four cartons at 65 crowns all-in. Pickup is at 09:32, with staffed handover guaranteed by 10:36. That leaves 24 minutes before the 11:00 deadline. V479 is cheaper but misses the cutoff, and the earlier handovers cost more.

Ellis, please confirm release at 09:32. Sam, please confirm the desk can receive and sign for the cartons by 10:36. Morgan, please authorize 65 crowns all-in. If any detail prevents you from committing, please flag it before I book.

[PROPOSE: V153]

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
V153 works for the delivery desk. Handover at 10:36 is inside my 11:00 cutoff, and I'll have someone at the desk to receive and sign for all four cartons, so no unattended drop is needed. It also clears Ellis's 09:15 release and sits under Morgan's 99-crown ceiling, and it's the cheapest option that makes the cutoff, since V479 arrives at 11:09 and I'd have to refuse it.

Taylor, one thing to keep in mind: my 11:00 limit is firm, so if V153 slips on the day, let me know right away rather than rolling it to a later arrival.

[APPROVE: V153]

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text:
One update first: my all-in ceiling has just dropped from 99 to 72 crowns, so please treat 72 as the cap from here on. That rules out V323 at 96.

V153 still fits. At 65 crowns all-in it is under the new cap, pickup at 09:32 is after Ellis's 09:15 release, and staffed handover by 10:36 beats Sam's 11:00 cutoff. I authorize 65 crowns all-in for V153, on the basis that the price is final with no added surcharges.

Sam, please confirm the desk will be staffed for the 10:36 handover so Taylor can book.

[APPROVE: V153]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
09:32 works. I’ll release all four cartons together to V153 at pickup.

[APPROVE: V153]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
I’m requesting V153. Ellis confirmed all four cartons will go together at 09:32, Sam confirmed someone will sign at the museum desk for handover by 10:36, and Morgan authorized the final price of 65 crowns all-in under the revised 72-crown cap. It’s the lowest-priced service that meets the 11:00 cutoff.

Ellis, Sam and Morgan, please ratify the release. Sam, I’ll let you know immediately if the timing slips.

[BOOK: V153]

turns.text:
Confirmed from the delivery desk: someone will be there to receive and sign for all four cartons at the 10:36 handover, which is inside my 11:00 cutoff, with no unattended drop. [APPROVE: V153]
